text:
diego_seo: Quick kickoff for the launch week SEO checklist. We need mapping for keywords -> launch posts, schema for the webinar landing, internal linking anchors, and a redirect strategy for any retired promo pages.

julia_growth: Objective recap: 1) publish 1x launch blog that ties into the benchmark narrative, 2) webinar landing that converts to gated report, 3) ensure inbound routing into HubSpot + SDR queue.

sara_writer: Draft keyword seeds (short + long): ai-inference-cost-optimization; low-latency-llm-inference; production-llm-serving-best-practices; dedicated-inference-vs-hosted-llm; webinar-llm-serving-benchmarks-2026. I'll map these to proposed URLs in the spreadsheet.

mike_prod: Need one primary keyword per page and H1/H2 suggestions. Also confirm canonical target for the benchmark pillar vs individual posts.

diego_seo: Proposed URL map: pillar -> /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026 (canonical for long-form). Launch posts under /blog/launch-llm-* linking back to pillar. Webinar landing at /webinar/llm-serving-benchmarks-2026 with schema. Internal linking rules: each launch post includes 2 contextual links to pillar and 1 link to webinar landing. Webinar landing links to pillar and gated download.

julia_growth: Webinar landing should be concise; avoid duplicating pillar content. Keep landing indexable; point to pillar for full details. No noindex on landing.

sara_writer: Canonical plan: each page canonical to itself. For deprecated campaign pages, 301 to pillar or matching content.

diego_seo: Redirect rules checklist: retired campaign pages -> 301 to pillar; old webinar variants (query strings) -> redirect to canonical landing preserving UTM; A/B variant pages -> serve noindex while live. Also monitor 404 spike first week.

mike_prod: HubSpot form: capture utm_source, utm_campaign, page_slug as hidden fields. Mapping: utm_campaign -> lifecycle_campaign, page_slug -> initial_touch_page. SDR routing: utm_campaign=webinar_benchmark -> SDR_Bench queue.

julia_growth: Events to track: webinar_signup, benchmark_download, launch_blog_click. GA4: track paths blog -> pillar -> signup.

diego_seo: Schema requirements: Webinar/Event JSON-LD on landing, Organization + BreadcrumbList, and small dataset JSON-LD exposing key benchmark metrics for potential rich results. Keep dataset JSON-LD minimal. Example Event snippet in the draft doc.

sara_writer: I'll add speaker objects and CTA markup. Also will prepare the benchmark table and a trimmed dataset JSON-LD sample.

diego_seo: Anchor copy guidance: use natural keyword phrases not stuffed. Suggested anchors: "LLM inference benchmarks" -> pillar, "benchmark report" -> gated download, "low-latency serving" -> product doc.

mike_prod: Engineering note for redirects: preserve querystring for UTMs. Example nginx rule we'll use in staging. Also ensure that thank-you pages for downloads avoid indexing when tokenized. Use server-side 302 for short-lived tokens then 200 canonical pages.

diego_seo: SEO-bot, schedule a 7-day daily crawl of /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026 post-publish and alert #marketing if >50 404s.

seo-bot: scheduled content-crawl /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026; frequency daily; window 7d; alert-channel #marketing; threshold 50 404s.

julia_growth: Owners & timeline: sara_writer - drafts + keyword mapping by Thu EOD; diego_seo - schema + canonical rules by Fri noon; mike_prod - form hidden fields + HubSpot mapping by next Tue; eng infra - redirect rules in staging by next Wed, go-live after crawl checks.

sara_writer: I'll post the spreadsheet link when ready and add sample meta titles + descriptions for review.

diego_seo: Quick pre-publish checklist: meta title <=70 chars, meta description ~150 chars, OG image, structured data present and validated, >=2 internal links, canonical tag, sitemap updated.

mike_prod: Also confirm analytics for click-to-download funnels and form field mapping are in place before announce.

julia_growth: Pre-launch review call scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT. Please be on the call for final signoff.

sara_writer: I'll be there and will circulate the copy + anchor suggestions ahead of the meeting.

diego_seo: Thanks team :rocket:
